override_precedence: This addendum supersedes conflicting severity, title, impact and normalized-total fields in phase-3-5-state-browser-evidence.json.

severity_overrides.title: Wiki acceptance profiles leak intentionally damaged EditorialMedia rows into later tests
severity_overrides.reason: Exact test ordering and frozen source show that prior Wiki media scenarios intentionally corrupt/remove files, leave rows without reset, and later projects request those stale rows. The dedicated fallback test explicitly expects HTTP 500 for a corrupt thumbnail.
severity_overrides.impact: Order-dependent acceptance evidence, repeated expected integrity-failure diagnostics in unrelated Wiki lifecycle tests, and possible interference with session-bearing request timing.
severity_overrides.recommendation: Reset Wiki EditorialMedia fixtures before and after each scenario; validate clean isolated and controlled polluted flows separately.

additional_findings.title: Invalid HTML pattern weakens native validation on Wiki key fields
additional_findings.capability: native client-side validation for category stable key and article content type
additional_findings.backend_status: Laravel request validation enforces the intended grammar.
additional_findings.frontend_status: Chromium historical evidence reports the HTML pattern as an invalid regular expression; the identical literal remains on frozen source.
additional_findings.impact: Native invalid-input feedback can be disabled or unreliable and the administrator forms emit console errors; no backend validation bypass is proven.
additional_findings.recommendation: Escape or reposition the hyphen and add a browser regression for patternMismatch and zero console errors.
